qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Public sector framework positions and UK scale do not protect against razor-thin 4.6% operating margins and periodic competitive re-tenders, evidenced by contract renewal rates dipping to 59% when resisting client pricing demands.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power). Mitie is a UK-focused facilities management and security outsourcer operating at razor-thin operating margins (4.6%-4.7%). Contracts are subject to periodic public and corporate tenders where clients aggressively re-bid contracts (FY25 renewal rate dropped to 59%), demonstrating low switching costs and absence of structural pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Mitie provides UK facilities management, cleaning, security, and technical maintenance. Operating margins before other items are structurally narrow at 4.6%-4.7%. The business relies heavily on low-wage labor vulnerable to National Living Wage and employer NIC hikes (£37m headwind), with public-sector clients frequently re-tendering contracts to competing outsourcers.
